content.title: About
content.content: Fruit juice, acai blend (5530) is a ready‑to‑drink beverage made from selected acai berries, apples, oranges and mangoes. It offers a bright berry flavor, a rich aroma and the characteristic deep purple hue of acai.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Acai berries grow in the tropical Amazon region and are renowned for their high antioxidant content.
The juice combines several fruits, enhancing both taste complexity and nutritional value.
Natural acidity of the fruits eliminates the need for artificial preservatives.
In the 2020s, acai‑based drinks saw a rapid rise in popularity across Europe and North America.
Packaging in dark glass bottles helps preserve light‑sensitive nutrients.

items.title: Rich in antioxidants
items.content: Acai berries contain anthocyanins and polyphenols that help neutralize free radicals and support cellular health.

items.title: Immune support
items.content: Vitamin C from oranges and mangoes boosts the body's immune defenses.

items.title: Source of healthy fats
items.content: Acai provides plant‑based omega‑3 and omega‑6 fatty acids, beneficial for heart health.

items.title: Digestive aid
items.content: Fiber from apples and mangoes promotes regular bowel movements and a feeling of fullness.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: The juice supplies vitamins B1, B2 and B6, essential for energy metabolism.

items.title: Fruit allergy
items.content: Individuals allergic to citrus or berries may experience a reaction to this product.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Although no sugar is added, the natural fruit sugars (fructose) may affect blood glucose levels; diabetics should monitor portion size.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: High acidity can irritate the stomach lining in sensitive persons.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: The juice is ready to drink straight from the bottle. It can be enjoyed chilled, used in smoothies, cocktails, or as a base for fruit desserts. For a milder taste, dilute with water.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the bottle in the refrigerator at 2 °C–6 °C. Once opened, consume within 5–7 days. Keep away from direct sunlight.
